newsitem.title: USA: Celgene to seek FDA review on thalidomide.
newsitem.headline: Celgene to seek FDA review on thalidomide.

text.p: Celgene Corp said Monday it would submit a new-drug application by the end of 1996 with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for the use of thalidomide in the treatment of erythema nodosum leprosem, a disorder associated with leprosy.

The company said it met on November 8 with the Dermatologic and Ophthalmic Drugs Advisory Committee to the FDA. The company said it would "move ahead with submission plans" and that it is "hoping for a timely and favorable review.
Celgene said it also completed the pivotal trial for the use of thalidomide in AIDS-related cachexia, a severe weight loss and wasting condition.
The company said it expected to submit a new drug application for cachexia, assuming satisfactory safety and efficacy data.
